key_points: CF Industries down 6.1% following President Trump's proposal for a U.S.-Belarus potash import deal
Multiple major financial outlets (WSJ, Barron's, Yahoo Finance, Simply Wall St.) report the decline
The deal threatens Canadian potash supply chains and could undercut fertilizer pricing for North American producers
Competitor Nutrien also fell significantly, indicating broader sector weakness
Analysts remain neutral overall but market sentiment is shifting bearishly due to this commodity supply shock
